testCases.title: Verify Pagination Controls are Displayed
steps: Navigate to the product display page.
expectedResults: Pagination controls are displayed at the bottom of the product grid.

testCases.title: Verify Click on Page Number Updates Product Grid
steps: Navigate to the product display page.
Click on a page number in the pagination controls.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to show products corresponding to the selected page.

testCases.title: Verify Current Page Number Highlighted
steps: Navigate to the product display page.
Click on a page number in the pagination controls.
expectedResults: The current page number is visually highlighted.
